mapper.select: SELECT surv_no , class_id , notice_no , surv_title , start_date , end_date , (CASE WHEN TRUNC(start_date) > SYSDATE THEN FIND_CODENAME('E301') WHEN TRUNC(end_date) < SYSDATE THEN FIND_CODENAME('E303') ELSE FIND_CODENAME('E302') END) AS surv_status , reg_date , FIND_CODENAME(account_type) AS account_type FROM survey ORDER BY end_date

SELECT surv_no , class_id , notice_no , surv_title , start_date , end_date , (CASE WHEN TRUNC(start_date) > SYSDATE THEN FIND_CODENAME('E301') WHEN TRUNC(end_date) < SYSDATE THEN FIND_CODENAME('E303') ELSE FIND_CODENAME('E302') END) AS surv_status , reg_date , find_codename(account_type) AS account_type FROM survey WHERE ROWNUM <= 5 AND class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY surv_no DESC

SELECT s.surv_no , class_id , notice_no , surv_title , start_date , end_date , (CASE WHEN TRUNC(start_date) > SYSDATE THEN FIND_CODENAME('E301') WHEN TRUNC(end_date) < SYSDATE THEN FIND_CODENAME('E303') ELSE FIND_CODENAME('E302') END) AS surv_status , reg_date , FIND_CODENAME(account_type) AS account_type , (SELECT FIND_CODENAME(surv_answer) AS surv_answer FROM survey_people p WHERE p.surv_no = s.surv_no AND p.member_id = #{memberId}) AS surv_answer , (SELECT surv_man_no FROM survey_people p WHERE p.surv_no = s.surv_no AND p.member_id = #{memberId}) AS surv_man_no FROM survey s WHERE class_id = #{classId}

SELECT surv_no , class_id , notice_no , surv_title , start_date , end_date , (CASE WHEN TRUNC(start_date) > SYSDATE THEN FIND_CODENAME('E301') WHEN TRUNC(end_date) < SYSDATE THEN FIND_CODENAME('E303') ELSE FIND_CODENAME('E302') END) AS surv_status , reg_date , FIND_CODENAME(account_type) AS account_type FROM survey WHERE class_id = #{classId}

SELECT surv_man_no , surv_no , member_id , member_name , FIND_CODENAME(surv_answer) AS surv_answer , FIND_CODENAME(account_type) AS account_type FROM survey_people WHERE surv_no = #{survNo} ORDER BY surv_no

SELECT surv_no , class_id , notice_no , surv_title , start_date , end_date , FIND_CODENAME(surv_status) AS surv_status , reg_date , FIND_CODENAME(account_type) AS account_type FROM survey WHERE surv_no = #{survNo} ORDER BY surv_no

SELECT q.question_no , q.surv_no , q.que_mark_no , q.question_content , FIND_CODENAME(question_check) AS question_check FROM survey_question q JOIN survey s ON (q.surv_no = s.surv_no) WHERE q.surv_no = #{surv_no} ORDER BY q.que_mark_no

SELECT a.answer_no , a.question_no , a.answer_content , a.ans_mark_no FROM survey_answers a JOIN survey_question q ON(a.question_no = q.question_no) WHERE a.question_no = #{questionNo} ORDER BY a.ans_mark_no

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.surv_answer = 'E402' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS surv_man_no FROM survey s JOIN survey_people p ON(p.surv_no = s.surv_no) WHERE s.surv_no = #{survNo} GROUP BY s.surv_no ORDER BY s.surv_no

surv_title = #{survTitle},
start_date = #{startDate},
end_date = #{endDate},
surv_status = #{survStatus},
account_type = #{accountType}
WHERE surv_no = #{survNo}
